title: Critique: consciousness belongs high in cognition

statements.text: Most accounts place consciousness high in the scale of biological complexity, at the level of cognition or above, as in global workspace, integrated information and higher-order thought theories, and explain it by integration or access rather than by feeling.

sources.quote: high in the scale of biological complexity, at the level of cognition or even higher

sources.locator: section 6, contrast with other theories of consciousness
sources.quote: In contrast to theories such as global neuronal workspace (GNW)
